description: Verified SafeList: boundary-checked list with get/set/push/pop. All index accesses are proven safe via requires preconditions. Follows the same pattern as std/container/safe_queue.mm and std/container/bounded_array.mm. The generated file MUST begin with a header comment block (// =========) identifying the module as 'SafeList', followed by a struct declaration: `struct SafeList { len: i64 where v >= 0, cap: i64 where v > 0 }`. Comments must be in Japanese to match the surrounding std style. Each atom follows the convention used in safe_queue.mm: `atom name(params) requires: ...; ensures: ...; body: { ... };`. Do NOT invent new operators, types, or syntax — use only what safe_queue.mm and bounded_array.mm already use.

atoms.name: safe_get
atoms.description: Get element at index. Requires 0 <= index < len (Out of Bounds prevention). Returns the index itself as a placeholder for the retrieved element value (consistent with safe_queue.mm style where atoms operate on length parameters, not on the underlying storage).

atoms.name: safe_set
atoms.description: Set element at index. Requires 0 <= index < len (Out of Bounds prevention). Returns the list length (unchanged).

atoms.name: safe_push
atoms.description: Append element to end of list. Requires len < cap (overflow prevention). Returns new length.

atoms.name: safe_pop
atoms.description: Remove last element. Requires len > 0 (underflow prevention). Returns new length.

atoms.name: safe_list_is_empty
atoms.description: Check if list is empty. Returns 1 if empty, 0 otherwise.

atoms.name: safe_list_is_full
atoms.description: Check if list is at capacity. Returns 1 if full, 0 otherwise.

atoms.name: safe_get_checked
atoms.description: Safe get variant: returns 0 (Ok) if index is valid, 1 (Err) if out of bounds. No panic.
